title: Intracranial current source density (CSD) during epileptic seizures and interictal periods, one patient (Budapest)
description: Derivative dataset of intracranial current source density (CSD) traces from a single 20-year-old patient with drug-resistant epilepsy, comprising 18 seizure segments and 16 interictal segments. CSD was computed by the data authors from subdural ECoG at four sites (fronto-lateral Fl1 and Fl2, inferior-parietal iP, and fronto-basal Fb) and converted to BrainVision format. The data were used to demonstrate causal inference between dynamical systems in epileptic activity (Benkő et al., arXiv:1808.10806). The mapping of the contact names in the files (GrB6, GrE2, GrF4, FbB3) to the paper's region labels is not stated by the source and remains uncertain.
methods_description: Subdural grid and strip electrodes (ADTECH, 10 mm inter-contact spacing) were implanted for pre-surgical evaluation. Video-EEG was recorded with a Micromed Brain-Quick System Evolution at 1024 Hz. CSD was computed by the data authors at four cortical sites (Fl1, Fl2, iP, Fb). The associated paper describes 1-30 Hz Butterworth filtering and rank normalization, but the source deposit does not state whether the stored values are before or after these steps. Each segment contains 20480 samples across 4 channels.
